revision_reason: M3-R1 proved that a four-candidate pilot pool cannot guarantee four successful expert episodes: Place Food produced only three successes. R2 adds a separate twelve-candidate pilot purpose while leaving every expert_candidate_pool, shared evaluation and common training seed unchanged.

derivation.conversion: big-endian first 8 digest bytes modulo 2147483646, then add 1
derivation.collision_rule: start retry at 0; increment only when the value is zero, duplicated anywhere in this contract, or appears in any frozen W10 validation seed file

expert_selection.rule: take the first 60 successful episodes in candidate-pool order; fail if the fixed 120 candidates contain fewer than 60 successes

w10_measurement_rollout_schedule.extension_trigger: use only aggregate W10 success/failure counts while social-root taxonomy labels remain sealed, and extend only when the preregistered power target is not met
w10_measurement_rollout_schedule.stop_rule: stop after a complete balanced batch once target power is reached, or at the fixed maximum; never extend based on social-root labels

route_seed_rule: B0, P, T, B, PT and PTB use the same common seed for a given purpose; the route name is deliberately not part of the derivation message
disjointness: all six tasks are mutually disjoint
all seeds are disjoint from the six W10 Validation20 seed files
R1 pilot seeds never enter the R2 pilot or formal metrics
pilot seeds never enter formal metrics
unused W10 measurement reserve seeds remain sealed and never enter metrics
validation5, validation20 and confirmation50 are mutually disjoint
